channel.title: Los Angeles News Group - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Los Angeles News Group (losangelesnewsgroup.com)

item.title: Genesis Invitational: Jacob Bridgeman ties 54-hole scoring record, leads by 6 at Riviera
item.description: Bridgeman shoots a 7-under 64 to take a six-shot lead over Rory McIlroy at 19-under as he chases his first PGA Tour title.

item.title: Mater Dei girls water polo loses to Oaks Christian in Open Division final
item.description: Mater Dei falls to defending champion Oaks Christian after leading by three goals in the first half.

item.title: Rights are just ‘words on a page’ if federal agents can ignore them
item.description: Individual rights are being erased and basic freedoms sacrificed on the altar of “mass deportations.”

item.title: Frost advisory for Santa Clarita and San Fernando Valleys for Sunday — temperatures at a low of 35
item.description: Calabasas/Agoura Hills, Santa Ynez Valley and Ojai Valley are included in a frost advisory released by the National Weather Service on Saturday at 7:48 p.m. The advisory is valid for Sunday, Feb. 22 between midnight and 9 a.m.

item.title: Donovan Dent’s OT layup lifts UCLA men to upset of No. 10 Illinois
item.description: Dent scores with one second left in the 95-94 win. Eric Dailey Jr. leads the Bruins with 20 points, and Tyler Bilodeau adds 18.

item.title: LAFC trounces Inter Miami, Messi in season opener
item.description: David Martinez, Denis Bouanga and Nathan Ordaz score in a 3-0 shutout. A crowd of 75,673 at the Memorial Coliseum watches LAFC open the season with a statement win over the MLS champions.

item.title: Valencia girls basketball fends off Windward in the Division 1 semifinals
item.description: Sophomore guard Kamilla Basyrova scores 20 points for Valencia, which will face La Salle in the championship game.

item.title: Man gets 28-year sentence for trafficking girl, woman along LA’s Figueroa Corridor
item.description: Derran Adkins, 28, also admitted he inflicted great bodily injury on both victims.

item.title: Santa Margarita girls soccer rallies to tie Oaks Christian, earns spot in finals
item.description: Felicity Nguyen scores the equalizer in the 54th minute as Santa Margarita reaches the Open Division championship game with a roster filled with underclassmen.

item.title: Anti-AI Luddites are on the rise in California
item.description: Free-market capitalism and technological progress have allowed even the poorer members of society to obtain goods once considered luxuries and substantially improved the standard of living.
